units.source_text: 然而，与其说名人习惯于平等的规则，莫如说更习惯于昔日的特权，

en.t: However, rather than saying that the Meijin was accustomed to rules of equality, it would be more accurate to say that he was accustomed to the privileges of the past,

units.source_text: 例如同吴清源五段对局的时候，

en.t: for example, when he played against Go Seigen, then fifth dan,

units.source_text: 由于名人生病不能顺利进行，甚至产生了可疑的流言蜚语。

en.t: the match could not proceed smoothly because the Meijin fell ill, and even dubious rumors began to circulate.

units.source_text: 因此这次充当告别赛的对手，

en.t: Therefore, in serving this time as the opponent in his farewell match,

units.source_text: 晚辈的棋手们似乎都用严格的对局条件，来防止名人为所欲为。

en.t: the younger players all seemed to use strict match conditions to keep the Meijin from doing as he pleased.

units.source_text: 这盘棋的对局条件，不是大竹七段同名人商订的，

en.t: The conditions for this game were not negotiated between Otake, seventh dan, and the Meijin,

units.source_text: 而是为了挑选名人的对手，在日本棋院的高段棋手们举行上手对局之前就决定下来的。

en.t: but had already been decided before the high-ranking players of the Nihon Ki-in held their handicap games to choose the Meijin's opponent.

units.source_text: 大竹七段作为高段的代表，争取让名人也遵守誓约。

en.t: As the representative of the high-ranking players, Otake seventh dan tried to make the Meijin abide by the pledge as well.
